sources.snippet: ZUNA Core ML: Enumerated Apple Profiles This repository contains Core ML conversions of ZUNA for Apple-native inference on iPhone, visionOS, and macOS, organized under enumerated profile folders. ZUNA is a 380M-parameter masked diffusion autoencoder for scalp EEG reconstruction and superresolution.
